# Моделеведение — Владимир Эммануилович Даревский

This file is an AI-oriented map of the open repository for the book *Моделеведение* (*Modelovedenie*) by Vladimir E. Darevsky (Vladimir Emmanuilovich Darevsky), published in 2022 by Pero (Moscow).

## Book

Title: Моделеведение / Modelovedenie
Author: Владимир Эммануилович Даревский / Vladimir E. Darevsky
Year: 2022
Publisher: Издательство «Перо», Москва / Pero, Moscow
Language: Russian

The book studies models and modeling as universal methods of knowledge, explanation, design, classification, and understanding. It covers mathematics, natural and technical sciences, history, sociology, political science, law, education, anthropology, religion, art, sport, propaganda, conflict studies, game theory, freedom, and other fields.

## Structure

The repository contains chapter files `glava-01.md` through `glava-30.md`, plus introductory and concluding materials.

The book has two major parts:

1. Глава I. Общие положения — basic concepts of modeling and model studies, model creation and selection, requirements, terminology, and classifications.
2. Глава II. Модели предметно-ориентированные — models used across many domains of knowledge and human activity.
